site.title: Ankole
site.description: Ankole is the open-source AI Workforce OS. Turn AI agents into autonomous labor that performs business functions and is measured by outcomes.
hero.subtitle: Turn AI agents into autonomous labor that performs business functions and is measured by outcomes.

difference.title: From AI capability to autonomous labor
difference.subtitle: A copilot helps a person perform the function. Ankole gives the function to an Agent, within defined authority, and measures what it delivers.
difference.function.title: A business function, not a chat persona
difference.function.body: Each Agent is an employee that owns a concrete business function: it has ongoing responsibilities, expected deliverables, operating context, and result measures. Its identity holds authority and history; it does not exist to imitate a person.
difference.outcome.title: Outcomes, not activity
difference.outcome.body: Judge the work by the number that matters to the business: return, risk, ranking, approval rate, cost per unit, or another declared result.
difference.loop.title: The Agent owns the execution loop
difference.loop.body: It plans, uses tools, follows up, recovers from failure, and delivers. People do not have to drive every next step.
difference.context.title: Operating context becomes committed work
difference.context.body: Rules, risks, decisions, and deadlines from channels and systems become durable inputs to later work, even when nobody addressed the Agent directly.
difference.governance.title: People govern the boundaries
difference.governance.body: Identity, AuthZ, approval points, audit records, and escalation paths define what the Agent can do. People remain responsible for approvals, exceptions, and accountability.
compounding.title: It will not make the same mistake twice
compounding.body: An assistant starts from zero every time: what you corrected yesterday, you say again today. Ankole turns AI agents into colleagues that file every correction into channel rules and skills, and it holds from the next session on. The second run of the same kind of job does not start where the first one did.
compounding.ledger.title: Channel rules · Research
compounding.r1.from: Settled between two people; nobody addressed the agent
compounding.r2.rule: Conclusion first, and never drop the risks
compounding.r3.rule: If the data is not there, say so — never estimate it
compounding.r3.from: Written into the skill after an incident
compounding.r4.rule: Value the HK listing on its own, not with the A-share line
compounding.after: After a rule lands in the ledger
compounding.log.p1: Most agents keep “memory” as an append-only log: what was said goes into a vector store verbatim and gets fished back by similarity. In that store an old rule and its replacement are equals — no timeline, nothing supersedes anything. Last month's “three-year percentile” lies beside this week's “seven years minimum”, and which one the next report uses depends on which one the search happens to land on.
compounding.log.p2: Ankole's memory adjudicates. A new rule takes the seat and the old one retires along with the period it governed; three corrections of the same kind merge into one sharper rule; contradictory conclusions are ranked by time, source, and confidence; and a prediction gets checked against how things actually went.
compounding.log.p3: All of it serves one objective — shrinking the gap between prediction and reality, the same path a living brain takes when it consolidates memory. So recall is not replay; it is reasoned out afresh against the present. The second run of the same kind of job starts from the adjudicated picture, and the same mistake has no room left to happen.
compounding.proof.title: The hardest evidence for any of this is Ankole itself
compounding.proof.body: This repository has an agent whose job is maintaining Ankole. Engelbart split work into three levels — doing the job, improving how the job is done, and improving the improvement — and the leverage grows as you climb. Running all three on itself is the only honest way to test the design.
capabilities.title: What lets it carry the job
capabilities.subtitle: One deployment can run long jobs, keep operating context current, watch the outside world, and give each business function a durable execution loop.
capabilities.async.title: Long jobs run in the background
capabilities.async.body: Background jobs, schedules, and check back later. A job can run for hours; when it finishes, the agent comes back to the same channel. If a step fails, it says which one, then retries.
capabilities.tacit.title: What the room already knows
capabilities.tacit.body: It hears what teammates say to each other. House rules, who prefers what, why an option did not survive last time — things nobody thought to tell an agent — settle into the channel's shared memory.
capabilities.brain.title: An enterprise world model built on ontology
capabilities.brain.body: Brain maintains an up-to-date enterprise world model built on an ontology similar to Palantir: it anticipates next steps from past experience and is continuously corrected by reality. Brain induces and deduces, absorbs external changes directly, and steadily refines institutional intelligence.
capabilities.research.title: Deep research, and playbooks
capabilities.research.body: Fan-out retrieval, layered checks, competing-hypothesis analysis. Once a kind of job runs well it becomes a playbook, and the next one follows it. You get a cited report, not a confident-sounding summary.
capabilities.browser.title: A browser it can really use
capabilities.browser.body: The runtime owns a real Chromium session and the agent drives it through ankole-browser: read the rendered page, click, type, take screenshots, run a repeatable Playwright script, and stay signed in across steps.
capabilities.skills.title: Skills retain lessons from real work
capabilities.skills.body: Ankole turns repeated Job problems and reusable human corrections into short, leased Skill lessons for one Agent. The base Skill stays unchanged. Operators can inspect, add, or retire each lesson.
capabilities.multi.title: Business function first
capabilities.multi.body: One Agent can own a narrow function, or several can share its execution. Authority, tools, memory, and outbound identity stay explicit. Multi-agent execution is optional.
capabilities.enterprise.title: Fits your identity and your IM
capabilities.enterprise.body: Lark, Slack, DingTalk, Teams, WeCom, and Google Workspace are first-class. Identity comes from the IdP you already run, so outbound identity, permissions, and audit follow the company directory.
usecases.title: Every business function has an outcome measure
usecases.subtitle: The work can be done digitally, produces an inspectable deliverable, and has a declared business result. Six examples, not a catalogue.
usecases.marketing.title: Performance marketing
usecases.marketing.deliverable: Campaign plans, bids, creatives, and budget shifts
usecases.marketing.metric: Incremental ROAS and customer acquisition cost
usecases.research.title: Industry research and trading
usecases.research.deliverable: Research, hypotheses, portfolio actions, and reviews
usecases.research.metric: Excess return, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown
usecases.seo.title: Search engine optimization
usecases.seo.deliverable: Keyword plans, content briefs, and on-page changes
usecases.seo.metric: Ranking movement and qualified organic traffic
usecases.regulatory.title: Regulatory submissions
usecases.regulatory.metric: First-pass approval rate and rounds of questions
usecases.patent.title: Patent prosecution
usecases.patent.deliverable: Prior-art searches, claim drafts, and office-action responses
usecases.audit.title: Smart contract audit
usecases.audit.deliverable: Reports with reproducible proofs of concept
usecases.quote: “Define the function. Grant bounded authority. Let the Agent work. Score the outcome.”
bets.title: Five technical bets underneath
bets.subtitle: Actors hold the identity and lifespan of long work, OTP supervision trees isolate failures, the Rust kernel and ZeroMQ carry native transport and live control, Agent Computer runs local execution, and PostgreSQL keeps durable facts.
bets.actors.title: Virtual Actors carry the AI work
bets.actors.body: Every job is a recoverable persistent computation with an address, state, mailbox, lifespan, and recovery path — not a loose task in the background.
bets.otp.title: OTP supervision trees draw the failure domains
bets.otp.body: Crashes are scheduling events, not disasters. When an agent hangs, times out, or crashes, Ankole isolates or restarts that branch, reconstructing state from the durable layer without taking the instance down.
bets.fabric.title: Rust kernel and ZeroMQ carry live control
bets.fabric.body: The Rust kernel provides shared native primitives and transport. Wakeups, steering, checkpoints, streaming, and backpressure all pass through a low-latency router, so you can intervene or take over while the agent is running.
bets.computer.title: Agent Computer is the execution floor
bets.computer.body: Bun Agent Computer manages agent execution with reconstructible worker-local state: the LLM loop, tools, files, terminal state, and streaming outputs all run in a Bun and TypeScript environment right next to the workspace.
bets.ledger.title: A durable ledger holds recovery and audit
bets.ledger.body: Mailboxes, turns, reminders, decisions, and committed actions outlive the process. Streaming is progress; what the agent commits is the fact.
quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.subtitle: Use Docker Compose on one Linux, macOS, or Windows host, Kubernetes for an enterprise deployment, or install from source.
quickstart.source.note: Get the toolchains ready with the installer in the repository, then start the full development environment with bun dev.
quickstart.docker.note: Run this Compose stack on Linux, macOS, or Windows wherever Docker can run Linux containers. It includes PostgreSQL, one Worker, and Caddy HTTPS.
quickstart.k8s.body: The public Helm chart deploys the verified image pair, shared Agent Home storage, and bundled or external PostgreSQL.
cta.title: Give it an objective, come back for the result
cta.body: Ankole is Apache-2.0 open source and self-hosted. Put it on your own machines and keep the context and the audit trail.
